title: Mirror Loop Validation

claims.claim: Forward and inverse calculations can establish computational closure within declared equations and assumptions.
Dimensional consistency is a necessary constraint but does not establish physical coupling.
A proposed bridge gains empirical support only when it survives independent observations and alternative explanations.
7.834/8 Hz coupling is not established by numerical proximity or mirror closure alone.
